reason: I already do my Sunday cooking by following free YouTube and TikTok clips, and green curry, tom yum and pad see ew are all on there for nothing. The two free dishes are ones I can already make without looking, so nothing here makes me want a 99 baht monthly bill, even with the first month free.
objection: I can watch a free video for this. Plenty of Thai cooks already show these exact dishes for free, so I don't see what the app adds that is worth paying for every month.
would_change_my_mind: A cook-ahead plan with its shopping list every Sunday instead of once a month, because planning my whole week's batch is the one thing free videos don't do for me.
